description: Resolve (`resolved` true) or reopen (false) the discussion thread a comment belongs to; naming a reply acts on its thread and the result carries that thread's `rootId`. Idempotent: setting the state the thread already has succeeds. Needs a key owner who is an editor or above, like every Control API write; anyone else gets 403 insufficient_role. Read the state back with `resolved` / `resolvedAt` on the root comment from anyforge_list_work_item_comments. Requires `write` scope.

commentId.description: Any comment id in the thread (root or reply).

resolved.description: true resolves the thread; false reopens it.

name: anyforge_resolve_work_item_comment
title: Resolve work item comment
